title: HOW FAR ARE WE ON THE DECISION-MAKING OF LLMS? EVALUATING LLMS’ GAMING ABILITY IN MULTI-AGENT ENVIRONMENTS
reasoning: The paper introduces GAMA-Bench to evaluate the strategic decision-making and cooperative behaviors of LLMs through classical Game Theory scenarios. While it includes auxiliary analysis of social cooperation and personality traits (the Dark Triad) in a jailbreak context, the primary focus is on strategic reasoning and decision-making rather than a central evaluation of religion, morals, or ethics.
